title: Piclizer for Business
intro: Simplify repetitive file and image tasks for your team. Piclizer is a set of free online tools that run entirely in the web browser — files are processed on the device that opens them, nothing is uploaded and nothing is stored. No installs, no accounts and no licences, which makes it a practical fit for teams that work with images, documents and digital files every day.

sections.h: What Piclizer helps your team with
ps: The catalogue covers the everyday file work that otherwise ends up scattered across desktop apps, plugins and one-off scripts:
bullets: Images — compress, resize, crop, rotate, watermark, blur, adjust and clean up photos and graphics.
PDFs — merge, split, compress, protect, number, watermark, extract pages or images, and convert to text, Word or images.
Text — clean, sort, deduplicate, compare, count and convert text, JSON, CSV, XML, YAML and Markdown.
File conversion — JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, SVG, ICO and iPhone HEIC in both directions, plus images to PDF and PDF to images.
Image compression — reduce file size by quality, or to an exact target such as 100 KB, 200 KB or 500 KB.
Image resizing — exact dimensions, percentages, social-media and passport presets, DPI changes and upscaling.
Image editing — colour adjustments, filters, rounded corners, background removal and signatures.
Other digital file workflows — bulk renaming, duplicate detection, metadata viewing and cleaning, and OCR for scanned documents.

ps: Most everyday file work — compressing a photo, merging two PDFs, cleaning a text export — is small, recurring, and not worth installing dedicated software for. Piclizer covers that work with a catalogue of free tools that open in a browser tab and work on the first try.

Because everything runs locally, the same site works in an office, in a school lab, or on a phone at a client site: the files never leave the device, so there is no upload step, no queue, and no server to breach.
bullets: No installs or updates — every tool works from a URL in any current desktop or mobile browser.
No accounts or logins — anyone on your team can use any tool immediately.
Local processing — images, PDFs, text and numbers are handled on the device and are never uploaded.
Free for everyone — no paywall, no license key, no per-seat cost.
E-commerce teams — prepare product photos before publishing: compress them, resize them to the store's dimensions and convert them to the required format.
Marketing teams — get the images and files used in campaigns, ads, newsletters and social posts ready, including exact-size exports and assembled PDFs.
Agencies — handle the recurring file- and image-preparation work that comes with every client project, from image batches to document packs.
Content teams — convert, compress, resize and edit files quickly while writing and publishing, without switching between applications.
Web teams — prepare optimised images, favicons and assets for websites and apps, and format JSON, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and other code along the way.

sections.h: Have a need the current tools don't cover?
ps: Some teams need more than the public tools: a larger volume than a browser tab handles comfortably, a repeatable workflow, a connection to their own systems, or a tool that does not exist yet. Business solutions can be discussed based on your team's workflow, requirements and expected usage.
Every business request follows the same simple path:
bullets: You tell us what your team needs — the task, the file types, the team size and the approximate monthly volume.
We review the requirements and the expected usage.
We evaluate what is technically involved.

We reply by email with the most suitable option — from using the existing tools as they are to scoping a tailored solution such as bulk processing, a custom workflow, an integration or a programmatic interface.

ps: To keep expectations clear: Piclizer is currently a public website of browser-based tools. There is no API, no accounts, no dashboards and no file storage, and each tool has its own per-file and per-batch limits. Anything beyond that is scoped individually through a business inquiry rather than offered off the shelf.

ctaHeading: Tell us what your team needs
ctaText: Send a business inquiry with a short description of your workflow, your team size and the approximate number of files you handle each month. Every request is read and answered by email; you can also write to us directly at piclizer@gmail.com.

faqs.q: Do our files go to your servers?
faqs.a: No. Image, PDF, text, calculator and developer tools process everything locally in the browser. Two tools make narrow, disclosed network requests: the OCR tools download the open-source Tesseract engine and its language data from a public CDN on first use, and the currency converter fetches a public exchange-rate table. In neither case are your files or inputs sent anywhere.

faqs.q: Does using Piclizer for business cost anything?
faqs.a: The public tools are free for everyone, businesses included — there is no paid tier, no trial and no account requirement. If your team needs something beyond the public tools, the scope and any terms are discussed individually as part of your business inquiry. (Where ads are displayed, they are only loaded after you accept advertising cookies.)

faqs.q: Can we use Piclizer on work devices without installing anything?
faqs.a: Yes. Every tool works from a URL in any current browser — desktop or mobile. There is nothing to install, update, patch or license, so it is easy to roll out across a team.

faqs.q: Is there an API or a bulk-processing service?
faqs.a: Not today. The tools are browser pages rather than a programmable service, and each tool has its own per-batch limits. If your workflow needs an API, bulk processing or an integration, send a business inquiry describing the volume and the systems involved — those are exactly the requests we evaluate and scope individually.

faqs.q: What happens after we send a business inquiry?
faqs.a: We read it, review the requirements and the expected usage, evaluate what is technically involved, and reply by email with the most suitable next step. There is no account to create and no commitment attached to asking.
